goal_command: /goal Neue konsolidierte Masterroadmap fertigstellen und danach alle offenen Odysseus-Punkte gate-getrieben mit ABC abschliessen, ohne neue Backend-Scheinslices zu erfinden.
goal: Finish all remaining non-UI Odysseus work by converting the completed backend roadmaps into bounded live/design decision packets, then execute one approved gate at a time with redacted evidence.
hard_rules: No legacy UI or v2 UI implementation from this backend ABC track.
No Docker-first assumptions; Odysseus runtime uses Podman/pods.
No private raw content, private paths, chat IDs, tokens, provider outputs or secrets in repo artifacts.
No live Telegram, Nextcloud, provider, host, deploy, backup, restore, Cloudflare, GitHub sync/write or remediation action without a bounded operator Go.
Push only to fuzzy/dev; never push to origin.
Do not touch unrelated dirty files unless the selected slice explicitly owns them.

completion_lanes.name: Version 1.0 Release Gate
completion_lanes.why_open: Backend MVP is complete, but official Version 1.0 requires the new UI to be live; deploy/tag/distribution remains separate live release work.
completion_lanes.done_when: New UI is live, /api/version-one/readiness is Go, rollback target is named, and release/deploy/tag/distribution decision is explicitly approved or consciously deferred.

completion_lanes.name: Calendar And Reminder Live Reliability
completion_lanes.why_open: Calendar/reminder repo slices are complete, but the 09:00 Telegram todo digest/reminder and CalDAV writeback paths still need bounded live evidence.
completion_lanes.done_when: One harmless recurring Telegram reminder/todo digest and, separately if approved, one CalDAV writeback smoke are created, delivered/observed, redacted and documented without multiplying one weekday reminder into multiple tasks.

completion_lanes.name: Autonomous Coding Runtime Control
completion_lanes.why_open: Autonomous coding contracts, sandbox evidence and runner state are repo-ready; real workstation-to-Telegram supervision, MCP availability and network/deploy gates remain operational decisions.
completion_lanes.done_when: A bounded coding task can be started/observed/paused from the approved control surface, checked in the sandbox, and reported over Telegram without Telegram becoming the primary development UI.

completion_lanes.name: MCP Workbench Activation
completion_lanes.why_open: Local MCP contracts and policy tests are ready, but Codex-side MCP services and local Odysseus MCP live smoke need explicit setup/evidence.
completion_lanes.done_when: Available Codex-side services are configured in the safe order: Playwright/browser, GitHub connector/MCP, docs MCPs, local Odysseus MCP smoke, Podman read-only probes; each has redacted read/write classification.

completion_lanes.name: Nextcloud Import Pilot And Memory Decision
completion_lanes.why_open: Copy-only Nextcloud live smoke is closed, full metadata inventory is complete, and local-only extraction/review executor exists; actual private-content extraction/review and Memory/RaptorGraph writes need a selected subset or refined safe-area rule.
completion_lanes.done_when: A bounded local-only document subset is extracted/reviewed by local model, aggregate gate summary is produced, and Memory/RaptorGraph writes are either explicitly approved for safe abstractions or deferred.

completion_lanes.name: Observability Ops On Debian
completion_lanes.why_open: Unified runtime logging, MCP debugging, incident models and Debian observability contracts are repo-ready; host metrics, Podman metrics, Loki/log shipping, Grafana exposure, CrowdSec and live smokes require operational Go.
completion_lanes.done_when: Debian host and Podman metrics/logs are collected with redaction, retention/exposure decisions are documented, and live observability smoke proves diagnosis without enabling unsafe remediation.

completion_lanes.name: Security Ops And Incident Tabletop
completion_lanes.why_open: Security incident response models and MCP debug surfaces are prepared; tabletop evidence and any CrowdSec/remediation/lockdown actions need explicit operator gates.
completion_lanes.done_when: A synthetic/redacted incident tabletop creates, diagnoses and resolves an incident through policy-gated actions; remediation remains disabled unless separately approved.

completion_lanes.name: UI-Owned Integration Handoff
completion_lanes.why_open: Backend contracts for legacy chat, internal refs, diagnostics, live affordances, PDF warnings and Version 1.0 readiness are ready; UI placement and implementation are owned by the UI agent.
completion_lanes.done_when: UI agent wires the existing backend contracts, new UI goes live, and backend ABC only verifies routes/readiness without changing legacy/v2 UI hotfiles.

completion_lanes.name: Memory/Raptor Runtime Reindex And Scale Foundation
completion_lanes.why_open: Tokenizer/chunking, Raptor cache and diagnostics are repo-complete; live reindex of real collections and Postgres/pgvector scale foundation are post-1.0 or evidence-driven.
completion_lanes.done_when: A live reindex/migration plan has rollback evidence and quality gates, or the track is explicitly deferred until diagnostics show a real scale problem.

completion_lanes.name: GitHub Issue Intelligence Live Rollout
completion_lanes.why_open: GHISS0-GHISS8 are repo-complete; live token setup, provider sync/write and optional schedule remain explicit post-MVP gates.
completion_lanes.done_when: A bounded repository sync/read path is approved and verified, and any write actions remain separately previewed and confirmed.

abc_execution_queue.done_when: The consolidated JSON roadmap exists, validates, and reflects the audited open gate families.
Operator selects exactly one gate family and one bounded smoke/action to execute next.

recommended_execution_order: OWM-1 Version 1.0 Release Gate: do not claim 1.0 until UI live.
OWM-2 Calendar/Reminder live smoke: fixes the missed 09:00 todo/reminder class first.
OWM-3 Autonomous Coding runtime control: prove remote supervision after reminder reliability.
OWM-4 MCP Workbench activation: install/test services when available, then use them as verification aids.
OWM-5 Nextcloud local-only pilot: only after subset/policy decision.
OWM-6 Observability Ops: Debian metrics/logging before broad security automation.
OWM-7 Security tabletop: synthetic incident before real remediation.
OWM-8 UI handoff: UI agent owns actual UI implementation.
OWM-9 Memory scale: live reindex/migration only with rollback and quality evidence.
OWM-10 GitHub live rollout: post-MVP, bounded and token-gated.

gate_family_table.next_decision: UI live or release-live actions deferred
Telegram reminder smoke or CalDAV writeback smoke
Workstation-to-Telegram smoke, MCP availability, or network allowlist
Debian observability inventory/setup, Grafana exposure, or log-retention evidence
Synthetic tabletop or explicit remediation/lockdown action
Hand backend contracts to UI owner

recommended_next_human_decision: Choose the next bounded live/design family. Safe recommendation: GO calendar_reminders bounded smoke, because the missed 09:00 Telegram todo/reminder is the freshest user-visible failure and the backend is already repo-ready.
